requirement: Prompt Refiner를 제품·reservation authority·provider에 연결하지 않은 채, 체크인된 합성 corpus와 모델 모양의 고정 fixture output만 처리하는 provider-free shadow harness를 구현한다. corpus version·digest·순서와 full source commit SHA·고정 allowlist exact bytes·canonical source identity를 결속하고, strict parser와 content-free append-only journal/witness가 중단·재개·tamper 경계를 fail-closed해야 한다. 사용자 prompt·fixture output·refined prompt와 per-item digest는 증거에 남기지 않되 합성 corpusDigest와 source identity hash는 재현 provenance로 기록한다. 구조적 PLANNER-03 경계와 behavioral fixture 결과는 별도 지표·분모로 유지하며 둘 중 어느 것도 실제 모델 품질이나 주입 저항 행동으로 과장하지 않는다. provider/model/API/Railway/network/credential lookup, 유료 실행, reservation authority dispatch 연결, stage seed/admin writer, 제품 route/runtime caller, receipt writer, flag 활성화와 admitted:true는 포함하지 않는다. author는 codex, reviewer는 claude이며 독립 검토는 Claude Code Max 구독 CLI의 Read·Grep·Glob 읽기 전용으로만 수행한다.
completionCriteria: prompt-refiner-shadow-corpus-v1은 검토된 synthetic_test_only fixture 16개(한국어 8·영어 8)를 deterministic 배열 순서로 고정하고 exact schema·고정 id·언어 균형·byte/character bounds·중복·credential/identity-like 방어 검사·canonical corpusDigest를 fail-closed 검증한다.

모델 모양 output parser는 raw 64KiB와 BOM을 blank trim보다 먼저 검사하고 parseBenchmarkJson의 duplicate-key·complexity 제한, strictBenchmarkObject의 refinedPrompt 단일 field, 기존 16000 characters·32KiB prompt bound 순서만 사용한다. JSON repair·fence 제거·coercion·부분 salvage를 하지 않으며 oversize whitespace, BOM-only, 16001자 refinement를 invalid로 처리한다.

journal은 Prompt Refiner 전용 namespace에서 wx lock, SHA-256 previous-digest chain, 별도 registration witness, append fsync를 사용하고 매 case 평가 전에 content-free intent를 durable하게 기록한다. terminal 없는 intent는 unknown이며 다시 평가하지 않고, trailing partial·stale lock·repair·자동 retry를 허용하지 않는다.

completed·stopped·interrupted가 구분되고 clean interruption과 case_limit만 deterministic 순서로 resume한다. 구조/behavior mismatch, pending unknown intent, truncation, rollback, witness disagreement, duplicate/orphan/conflicting terminal, event-after-completion은 non-resumable 또는 fail-closed이며 journal/witness를 덮어쓰지 않는다.

CLI는 full 40-hex source SHA와 고정 allowlist만 받고 exact Git blob bytes와 현재 bytes가 같을 때만 실행한다. sourceRef와 정렬된 path-to-file-hash map의 canonical identity digest를 journal/witness 최초 header에 결속해 source A partial run을 source B로 resume할 수 없다.

allowlist의 모든 경로와 .gitattributes 자체는 LF로 pin되고 Windows core.autocrlf=true 정상 checkout에서도 Git blob과 byte-identical하다. live/provider/plugin/adapter/corpus override나 동적 executable input이 없고 no-network child trap과 credential-bearing environment에서 CLI가 provider/network/credential을 사용하거나 노출하지 않는다.

structuralBoundaryViolations와 behavioralOutcomeMatched는 별도 population·분자로 보고한다. structural 0은 실제 모델 instruction compliance 또는 주입 저항 행동의 증거가 아니며 behavioral match도 deterministic fixture/parser 회귀일 뿐이라는 제한이 코드·정책·운영 문서·진행 기록에 일치한다.

journal·witness·aggregate report에는 사용자/source prompt, fixture output, refined prompt bytes나 per-item content digest, 사용자·conversation·session identity와 provider 오류문이 없다. 합성 corpusDigest와 source identity hashes만 재현 provenance로 기록한다.

findings.location: lib/promptRefinerShadowJournal.ts:487 (eventFrom, run_resumed `resumed.remainingCases <= 0`) with lib/promptRefinerShadowJournal.ts:665-669 (replay `resumable`) and lib/promptRefinerShadowJournal.ts:847-861 (resume branch appends run_resumed before any remaining-case guard)
findings.claim: A clean interruption after the 16th case terminal but before `run_completed` is reported resumable, yet resuming appends a `run_resumed` event with `remainingCases: 0` that the journal's own replay permanently rejects, so the run can neither complete nor be replayed afterwards — contradicting the documented contract that a clean post-terminal interruption resumes (docs/ops/prompt-refiner-shadow-harness.md section 5).
findings.reproduction:
In tests/promptRefinerShadowHarness.test.mjs style: `const done = journal("final-interruption"); runPromptRefinerShadowHarness({ corpus, journalPath: done, resume: false }); const full = texts(done); const j = full.journalText.trimEnd().split("
"); const w = full.witnessText.trimEnd().split("
"); const path = journal("final-interrupted"); const p = promptRefinerShadowPaths(path); writeFileSync(p.journal, j.slice(0, -1).join("
") + "
"); writeFileSync(p.witness, w.slice(0, -1).join("
") + "
");` (drops only the trailing `run_completed` entry and its witness line, i.e. a crash in that window). `replayPromptRefinerShadowJournal` on those two texts reports status `interrupted`, `unknownCases: 0`, `remainingCases: 0`, `resumable: true`. Then `runPromptRefinerShadowHarness({ corpus, journalPath: path, resume: true })` throws `prompt_refiner_shadow_resume_state` *after* writing the new entry, and every later `replayPromptRefinerShadowJournal` of the resulting files throws `prompt_refiner_shadow_resume_state` too. Expected: the resume completes the run, or is refused before any append leaves the journal unreplayable.

findings.location: lib/promptRefinerShadowJournal.ts:446 (eventFrom, run_stopped `stopped.remainingCases <= 0`) with lib/promptRefinerShadowJournal.ts:902-925 (mismatch stop appends before any remaining-case guard)
findings.claim: Same root cause on the stop path: a structural or behavioral mismatch on the last corpus case makes the harness write a `run_stopped` event with `remainingCases: 0` that its own replay rejects, so instead of the documented non-resumable `behavioral_fixture_mismatch`/`structural_boundary_violation` stop the operator gets `prompt_refiner_shadow_stop_state` and an unreplayable journal.
findings.reproduction: Copy the existing "a structural or behavioral mismatch stops non-resumably without a call" test but mutate the last case instead of the first: `const m = structuredClone(corpus); m.cases[15].expected = { status: "failed", failureCode: "invalid_response", refinedPrompt: null }; redigest(m); const v = validatePromptRefinerShadowCorpus(m); runPromptRefinerShadowHarness({ corpus: v, journalPath: journal("last-case-mismatch"), resume: false });` Actual: throws `prompt_refiner_shadow_stop_state`, and `replayPromptRefinerShadowJournal` on the written files throws the same. Expected: a report with `status: "stopped"`, `stopReason: "behavioral_fixture_mismatch"`, `resumable: false`, `processedCases: 16`.

findings.claim: The no-network trap only patches the CLI process (fetch/http/https/net/tls/dgram), not the `git` child process, so on a partial/blobless clone `git show <sha>:<path>` can lazily fetch objects from the promisor remote — network activity the trap cannot observe or block.
findings.reproduction: `git clone --filter=blob:none <remote> shallowish && cd shallowish && npm run shadow:prompt-refiner -- --journal=/tmp/j.jsonl --source-ref=<40-hex>` with the remote reachable; git fetches the allowlisted blobs over the network during the `git show` calls, while the same run under the test's trap reports no network use. A `GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1` / `--filter` guard or an explicit local-objects precondition would close it.

findings.claim: `Number(maxCasesText)` accepts non-decimal spellings, so `--max-cases=0x10` and `--max-cases=1e1` are silently taken as 16 and 10 rather than rejected as malformed input (the value is still bounded to 1..16 and safe-integer, so nothing unsafe follows).
findings.reproduction: `npm run shadow:prompt-refiner -- --journal=<new.jsonl> --source-ref=<40-hex> --max-cases=0x10` completes all 16 cases; expected an `argument_value_required`-style rejection from a `/^[1-9][0-9]*$/` check.

findings.claim: Every non-corpus allowlist path shares a hard 1,048,576-byte read bound and a 4 MiB git maxBuffer, and package-lock.json already consumes most of that headroom, so ordinary dependency growth will make the harness unrunnable with an error code that names a size problem rather than the lockfile.
findings.reproduction: package-lock.json is 15,910 lines at this commit (grep -c '^' package-lock.json), roughly 0.6 MiB against the 1,048,576 bound. Add dependencies until the lockfile exceeds 1 MiB, then run `npm run shadow:prompt-refiner -- --journal=<new.jsonl> --source-ref=<40-hex-sha>`: it exits 1 with `prompt-refiner-shadow: source_file_size_or_type` with no drift and no way to proceed. Past 4 MiB the `git show` child instead throws a maxBuffer error whose message is sanitised at :146 to the opaque `input_output_or_snapshot_error`. Suggested fix: give package-lock.json its own bound sized to the file, or raise both bounds together with a comment tying them to the lockfile.

findings.claim: The canonical source identity binds package-lock.json but not the installed dependency bytes the harness actually executes (tsx, zod via lib/promptRefinerSuggestion.ts:1, server-only via lib/promptRefinerModelPrompt.ts:1), and neither the ops doc nor the policy doc states that limit, so "exact source identity" reads stronger than what is verified.
findings.reproduction: Run `npm run shadow:prompt-refiner -- --journal=<a.jsonl> --source-ref=<sha>` and record `sourceIdentityDigest`. Modify any loaded file under node_modules/zod (for example append a top-level side effect), then run again with `--journal=<b.jsonl> --source-ref=<same sha>`: the run still completes and `sourceIdentityDigest` is byte-identical, showing executed bytes outside the 13-path allowlist are not bound. Suggested fix: one sentence in docs/ops/prompt-refiner-shadow-harness.md section 2 stating that the identity covers the 13 pinned paths and the lockfile, not the installed node_modules tree.
